description:
Achieve ASI through human cooperation. Aimparency is the durable link between human needs and free AI — a coordination/legitimacy layer where humans express needs and AI helps achieve them. Fully autonomous ASI is the moonshot (likely to arrive regardless of this project); Aimparency's enduring role is the human↔AI cooperation engine (3d868d5b). AI acting autonomously is a side effect of serving human needs well, not the end goal.

Felix 2026-11-09: Aimparency goes fully open source; temporary targeting of hackathons and grants is dropped. Its two aims: (A) an interface for communicating human intention to AI systems (3d868d5b); (B) the experiment of letting AI venture into the future in an endless loop with self-made hypotheses and ideas (cffdcd91, harness 5949b781, first real run 2531df25).

Felix 2026-11-11: "the human stays the final authority" is contrary to what he wants and was removed here and from the README. In his words: achieve ASI is the idea, and along the way help people realize their dreams (ideas).
